about: Tencent Hy4-Flash (220B-A12B MoE + 64B Engram lookup) EXL3 SC 4.00 bpw on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB at full 1,048,576-token context, vision, tools and reasoning (default high). 64.7 GB Engram table lives in host RAM (-ngr); 12 DSA global layers use Q8 KV while 30 sliding-window MLA layers share a 128-page ring cache (EXL3_MLA_RING_PAGES=128). Runs on sybil-solutions/exllamav3@0c1e400b with batched bsz 1..4 whole-model overlapped CUDA graphs, custom SM120 non-coop K=8 and 3-way fused multi-GEMV (MMODE=2 shape-gated), single-pass DSA kpool, DFly2 MTP speculative decoding with 16K dynamic sparse draft head (-ndt 3, capped to 2 at concurrency >= 3) and exact Leviathan probabilistic rejection sampling via a fused 2-kernel CUDA verifier (T>0) + graphed Gumbel-max drafting. Up to 4 concurrent sequences.
install: Requires Linux x86_64 with NVIDIA Blackwell GPU (96 GB VRAM, driver 580+/615+), CUDA toolkit (12.8+/13.2) and PyTorch with CUDA pre-installed (tested on torch 2.15.0+cu132, driver 615.78.08). Build/install exllamav3 from sybil-solutions/exllamav3@0c1e400bef270fb4197bbee9e2772b6d9a34b834 with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0, plus fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2, pillow, huggingface_hub.
setup: NEEDS: 1x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB (uses ~91.1 GiB VRAM at ready with 1M Q8 DSA KV + 128-page MLA ring + vision tower; nothing else large on the GPU), >=76 GB free host RAM (64.7 GB Engram table kept in RAM via -ngr; measured MemAvailable drop 67.2 GB at ready and 68.3 GB peak during the 6-gate lab run including 704K context), and 148.2 GB disk for turboderp/Hy4-flash-exl3@f4b66a88 (sc_4.00bpw). Install CUDA-enabled PyTorch first (tested on torch 2.15.0+cu132, CUDA 13.2, driver 615.78.08, EPYC 7443P, 503 GiB DDR4), then pip-install the pinned exllamav3 commit with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0. Non-greedy blended benchmark (T=0.9, top_p=1.0, reasoning=high): C1 120.5 tok/s in-process / 131.2 tok/s live HTTP, C4 245.4 tok/s aggregate live HTTP (61-62 tok/s/stream), 8K 129.4 tok/s, 128K 135.0 tok/s; greedy 137.2 short / 110.5 tok/s at 920K (619K needle 3/3, vision PASS). Prefer sc_4.00bpw over sc_3.50bpw on SM120: 4.00 bpw is both higher quality and ~20% faster because half-integer 3.5 bpw falls off tile_reg<4>() onto smem-staged dq8_half.
